create_llm_training_params: create an LLMTrainingParams instance to configure language model fine-tuning with LoRA and custom learning rate
create_text_classification_params: create a TextClassificationParams instance to configure text classification training with a BERT model
create_tabular_params: create a TabularParams instance to configure tabular data training with XGBoost hyperparameter search
create_image_classification_params: create an ImageClassificationParams instance to configure image classification training with a ViT model
create_seq2seq_params: create a Seq2SeqParams instance to configure sequence-to-sequence training with a FLAN-T5 model
